description: Remove clips from the sequence (Clear), or close the gap they leave with ripple: true (Ripple Delete). One undo step

clips.description: Which clips: items (track, trackIndex, clipIndex from list_clips) and/or selected: true for the clips selected in the Timeline

items.description: A clip in the sequence, as list_clips reports it

clipIndex.description: Clip index on the track, 0 = first

selected.description: Include the clips selected in the Timeline

ripple.description: Close the gap: later clips move earlier. Default false

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

name: remove_clips
title: Remove Clips
